entities.summary: India Tower is an unbuilt 126-story, 707.5 m (2,321 ft) megatall skyscraper in Mumbai, India. Originally planned for completion in 2016, construction was put on hold in May 2011 due to disputes between the developers and Mumbai's civic authorities, and later cancelled in 2015.
